works.title: DIKLIS CHUMP: Loser Legacy
works.description: A satirical political fiction depicting an authoritarian regime's progression through collapse stages, mapping regime behavior through paired 'reality' and 'propaganda' bullets across constituencies (followers, military, media, clergy). The work exposes contradictions between authoritarian rhetoric and actual consequences through multi-stage scenario development.
works.quote: Issue/Policy/Attitude: My Followers Betrayed Me—It's All Your Fault. Authoritarian Stage: Stage 6: Total Collapse or Eternal Rule

works.title: Relationship Memoir with Ashley
works.description: Personal memoir reconstructing an on-again/off-again relationship through OCR'd iMessage transcripts and timeline analysis, applying Buddhist principles (Lamrim) and a polarity/sovereignty framework (muse framing, pedestal-vs-pit reframe) to explore relational dynamics. Planned as an anonymous personal narrative examining connection, spiritual growth, and masculine grounding.
